name: Howard Peterson
source:
Faction: Terran
Birthday: September 20, 2357
Place of Birth: New York
Occupation: Admiral of the Fleet
Affiliation: United Terran Vanguard
Voice Actor: George Ledoux

Profile:
Elevated to the rank of Admiral of the Fleet by the United Earth Defense Council, Howard Peterson has earned a reputation as a tenacious battlefield commander as well as a father to his men. His uncanny knack for putting the right person in the right place has served Terran interests well time and time again.

He is known for considering the worst-case scenario, and being seemingly able to see the doubt that lingers in the hearts of men.

As a decorated veteran of the UTV having served for nearly thirty years, only his chronic illness serves to impair his otherwise impeccable judgement.
translation:
阵营：地球人
生日：2357年9月20日
出生地：纽约
职业：舰队上将
所属：联合地球先锋队
配音：George Ledoux

简介：
霍华德·彼得森被联合地球防卫委员会提升为舰队上将，以坚韧的战场指挥官和部下的父亲闻名。他总能把合适的人放在合适的位置，一次又一次地为地球人利益立下功劳。

他习惯考虑最坏情况，似乎还能看穿人们心中挥之不去的疑虑。

作为在UTV服役近30年的功勋老兵，唯一妨碍他完美判断力的，是长期疾病。
